resume: L'inversion après une expression négative ou restrictive en tête de phrase (never, rarely, not only, no sooner, hardly, under no circumstances, only when…) et l'inversion conditionnelle (should, were, had).

sections.contenu:
Pour un effet **emphatique** ou **soutenu**, on place en tête une expression négative ou restrictive, puis on **inverse** auxiliaire et sujet (comme dans une question) :

| Expression | Exemple |
| --- | --- |
| *Never (before)* | ***Never have I seen** such a mess.* |
| *Rarely / Seldom* | ***Rarely does he** admit his mistakes.* |
| *Not only … but (also)* | ***Not only did she** finish early, but she also helped the others.* |
| *No sooner … than* | ***No sooner had we arrived than** it started to rain.* |
| *Hardly / Scarcely … when* | ***Hardly had I sat down when** the phone rang.* |
| *Under no circumstances* | ***Under no circumstances should you** share your password.* |
| *Not until / Only when* | ***Only when** I read the report **did I understand** the problem.* |
| *Little* | ***Little did they know** that…* (ils étaient loin de se douter) |

Au présent et au prétérit simples, il faut ajouter ***do / does / did***.

Dans un registre **formel**, on peut supprimer *if* en inversant :
- ***Should*** (1er conditionnel, éventualité) : *If you need help…* → ***Should you need** any help, please contact us.* (formule d'e-mail très courante)
- ***Were*** (2e conditionnel) : *If I were in charge…* → ***Were I** in charge, I would…* ; avec un verbe : ***Were we to** cancel, we would lose the deposit.*
- ***Had*** (3e conditionnel) : *If I had known…* → ***Had I known**, I would have come.*

Négation : ***Had I not*** *seen it…* (jamais ~~Hadn't I~~).

cartes.question: Complète : Never ___ such a beautiful view.
Complète : Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents.
Complète : No sooner ___ the house than it started to snow.
cartes.explication: No sooner + past perfect inversé … than.

cartes.recto: Réécris avec « Under no circumstances » : « You must never leave the server room open. »
cartes.verso: *Under no circumstances **must you** / **should you** leave the server room open.*

cartes.recto: Traduis : « Ils étaient loin de se douter que… »

cartes.question: Formule d'e-mail formelle : « Si vous avez des questions, n'hésitez pas à me contacter. »
choix: Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Should you to have any questions, …
Had you any questions, please contact me.
If should you have any questions, …

cartes.recto: Réécris : « If they hadn't helped us, we would have failed. »
cartes.verso: *Had they not helped us, we would have failed.*
